title: Pulse v3 selection platform contracts
description: Authoritative v3 API seed. v1/v2 symbol-ID schemas are historical. Business semantics, auth, source contracts and database concurrency still require implementation.

Timestamp.description: Canonical API instants use UTC Z. Adapters may accept offsets but must normalize. Date precision is separate.

Decimal.description: Finite numeric(38,12) compatible decimal string. No exponent, comma, NaN, Infinity, implicit float or silent rounding.

Probability.description: Calibrated probability for an explicitly defined event; relative scores are not probabilities.

Timeframe.description: m=minute; mo=calendar month; boundaries use CalendarService.

FieldQualityEntry.description: Raw facts remain immutable. Model estimates use derived status and cannot overwrite observed facts.

ResponseMeta.description: All fields are explicit; null analysis metadata is allowed for user-layout/operational responses. A cursor binds the release, scope, sort and optional actionability_id.

AnalysisRelease.description: Only READY or previously published SUPERSEDED releases are public read sources. A normal publish stage is forward-only; rollback needs a separately specified command.

FeatureKey.description: Canonicalize serialization while preserving the declared instrument_ids sequence. Reordering can change outputs. Stable sorting is allowed only when the feature definition explicitly declares an unordered set, and that rule is part of definition_version. The full key is stored in market.feature_result.full_key; dependency_digest covers the exact dependency closure.

available_at.description: Actual normalized version completion time; never backdated for historical replay.

policy_usable_at.description: Optional derived query field under response availability_policy_version. Not a stored source fact or replacement for available_at.

CanonicalBar.description: Unadjusted source-normalized bar; volume and turnover are interval values. OHLC ordering, finality, calendar, and availability are semantic checks beyond JSON Schema.

available_at.description: Actual normalized version completion time; never backdated for historical replay.

policy_usable_at.description: Optional derived query field under response availability_policy_version. Not a stored source fact or replacement for available_at.

AdjustedBar.description: Derived chart series; adjusted prices never use *_raw names or feed execution without an explicit inverse mapping.

BarWindow.description: A READY bars.window artifact certifies the requested coverage. All bar modes must match the window; empty and incomplete are different.

RankingEntry.description: action_rank is frozen under the publication context. Current account-specific ordering is account_action_rank in ActionabilitySnapshot.

SectorOverview.description: Items are taxonomy nodes, never instrument UUIDs. Each run has one rank_kind and a fixed membership snapshot.

ActionabilitySnapshot.description: Buy checks cash and permissions; sell checks eligible inventory. Conditions being eligible are not fills/reservations. Paging and reordering pin this actionability_id; changed quotes/account create a new snapshot.

FeatureOperand.description: Semantic feature reference. Runtime triggers resolve a fresh explicit FeatureKey under resolution policy; initial_feature_key_hash anchors the compiled explanation and must not freeze all future trigger values.

Condition.description: TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN semantics; UNKNOWN never fires. Operands require compatible units. No eval/SQL/Python strings. Crosses require both prior and current confirmed observations.

PriceZone.description: Semantic validation requires lower<=upper. A trigger zone is not a guaranteed execution price.

TradePlan.description: One immutable (plan_id,plan_version). State/content transitions append a version. Formal plan states remain the five canonical values; a validated plan is not a fill or an inventory reservation.

specification.description: Role-specific input/output/state/evaluation contract. Each strategy must register its concrete specification schema.

Seat.description: Official disclosure timing and trigger coverage are retained. Historical seat-style hypotheses require separate evaluation; no hardcoded next-day certainty.

Workspace.description: projection_hash binds only the persisted frozen analysis projection. Persist quote_overlay/actionability_id as null in that frozen artifact; API may compose independent current overlays without rewriting this hash or release component. ResponseMeta.generated_at is response time, not a new analysis publication.

AccountProjection.description: cash_available is a derived view, not an extra asset. Withdrawal depends on channel policy; unknown remains null. Valuation snapshot is a market dataset_manifest, not a fabricated valuation table. pnl_from_cost_origin_cny is a cost-origin bridge, not automatically period return or TWR. NAV = external capital + realized gross + unrealized + dividend income - transaction cost - tax.

layout_document.description: Persistent panel/timeframe/indicator configuration. The full editor document schema must be registered; market result matrices are not embedded here.

UpdatePage.description: Polling recovery seed. A transport-specific SSE endpoint can reuse these events after replay/retention tests; expired cursor triggers snapshot refresh.

CanonicalQuote.description: Raw quote fields retain actual source/observation times. Missing L1 or price/time remains null; a daily close is never substituted as a live quote.

QuoteSnapshot.description: quote_snapshot_id pins immutable quote facts. Freshness is a derived assessment at freshness_evaluated_at, so an unchanged old quote can become stale without fabricating a new market observation. Actionability records the exact quote_snapshot_id and its own checked_at.

AvailabilityPolicy.description: Persisted available_at is always actual completion. Historical reconstruction derives policy_usable_at in the query/manifest using this rule and explicit delay assumptions; it never rewrites source/observation available_at.
